_comment: STAGED, NOT ACTIVE. Merge the `credentialPool` block below into ~/.relayplane/config.json to activate the usage-aware failover pool. See README-credential-pool-flip.md. Absent = unchanged single-token behavior (live 4100 default). Do NOT merge into the 4100 config until the 4101 dual-account + stale-token verification passes on a confirmed account B.

credentialPool._note: Account A = primary (priority 1, first in list). The account this box is logged into via Claude Code. refresh:false so we never race Claude Code's own token rotation.

Account B = fallback (priority 2). A SECOND Max account NOT logged into Claude Code here. refresh:true so the proxy's refresh loop keeps its OAuth token fresh. Populate this file from a dedicated `claude login` into a separate creds file, or a confirmed copy of the second account's ~/.claude/.credentials.json.
